title: Uttarakhand High Court Questions Police Over Detention Of Politician En Route To CJP's Parliament March
description: The Uttarakhand High Court on Monday (July 20) questioned the police over the circumstances in which Uttarakhand Parivartan Party (UPP) president Prabhat Dhyani was detained after he announced on social media that he would participate in Cockroach Janta Party's march towards Parliament, in support of students protesting the alleged NEET paper leak. The Court also sought an explanation from the police as to why Dhyani—an adult—was allegedly handed over to his mother after being released, instead
